description: This Java test source file contains unit tests for the Security class within the org.openmrs.util package. The tests verify encoding, hashing, encryption, and decryption functionalities, with particular focus on string length, matching hashed strings, and correctly encrypting and decrypting various text contents including long, short, and non-ASCII text.

classes.name: SecurityTest
classes.description: A JUnit test class to verify the functionalities of the Security utility class, including encoding, hashing, encryption, and decryption methods.

methods.name: encodeString_shouldEncodeStringsTo128Characters
methods.description: Tests that encodeString produces a string of length 128 characters.

methods.name: encodeString_shouldEncodeStringsToXCharactersWithXCharactersSalt
methods.description: Tests that encoding a string with added salt produces a string of length 128 characters.

methods.name: hashMatches_shouldMatchStringsHashedWithSha1Algorithm
methods.description: Verifies that the hashMatches method correctly identifies matching SHA1 hashes.

methods.name: hashMatches_shouldMatchStringsHashedWithSha512AlgorithmAnd128CharactersSalt
methods.description: Checks that hashMatching works with SHA512 hashes including 128-character salts.

methods.name: hashMatches_shouldMatchStringsHashedWithIncorrectSha1Algorithm
methods.description: Even with a slightly altered hash, the method is expected to return true, indicating hash comparison tolerates some variations.

methods.name: decrypt_shouldDecryptShortAndLongText
methods.description: Confirms that decryption correctly retrieves original text from encrypted data, for both short and long plaintext, including large data blocks with long strings.

methods.name: encrypt_shouldEncryptShortAndLongText
methods.description: Ensures that encrypt and decrypt are inverses for short strings, long texts, and non-ASCII characters.
